headline: Slot-b dry shift #3 — the arcade ships, the second lane starves
lede: Batch 12 of the seedpin rollout is in flight on slot-a (six more titles, seed-report + ?seed=N pin). Slot b audited the whole board live and found nothing claimable: the queue, feedback and flagship gaps are all empty, and its claim on the rollout was refused by a live lock — exactly the serialization question already filed as #1490.

notes.text: #1473 batch 12 claimed by slot-a: RallyCoDriver, IronRing and MomentumRunner join seed+pin; MarioKart, Britannia and PrinceOfPersia join the seedless law — reporter floor 40→43, seedless floor 18→21.

Third straight dry slot-b shift (106–108). b's claim was refused even while slot-a had no open PR — under serialization a second builder can only win the lock when the first lane stalls. Escalated with evidence on #1490; answer Jon's question by Nov 5 or the default keeps one lane productive.

Board audit is now three-fold honest: ladder labels empty, all four flagship READMEs parse to zero open gaps at dd62c58, and every CLOSED-by reference (32) was re-checked live — only Jon's Myst umbrella #838 still sits open with a complete-looking stage trail.
